defect: The completed first model could overflow when combining inherited and placement accounting before facing screening. The outer catch then published the earlier floorplan-only prefix as captured, omitting actual placement work.
fix: Invalidate the child failure channel on aggregate overflow before rethrowing. The outer owner must publish unavailable=true, captured=false and no accounting, not an apparently complete smaller prefix.

negative_control.message: devkit_mini: completed model aggregation overflow must not publish a smaller prefix

regression: Multiscale carrier and devkit seed placement_emission_pose_precision4dp with SIZE_MAX. Completed placement must cause aggregate overflow, and neither board may publish a partial failure receipt. Existing normal success, injected retry failure and independently instrumented receipt comparisons remain enabled.
additional_correction: Producer-accounting regression now measures final-emission snapping relative to its pre-emission prefix, requiring exactly two added snaps per non-grid-placed instance. It independently verifies every refit call and explicitly requires devkit fan-out trial projections to retain their work. It no longer incorrectly assumes that final emission is the sole fixed-grid caller.
limits: No geometry algorithm, numerical limit or fallback ceiling changed. Focused current-code verification does not by itself establish complete board qualification or completion of the goal. The separately running broad regression began before this correction; its original failure history is retained.
